description: This file contains the implementation of MidiOutputPortConnectionSelector, a class that manages MIDI output port selection and connection to a destination device within an Android MIDI application.

classes.name: MidiOutputPortConnectionSelector
classes.description: Manages selection of an output MIDI port and connects it to a specified destination device and port.

methods.name: MidiOutputPortConnectionSelector
methods.description: Constructor initializing the selector with MIDI manager, activity context, spinner ID, destination device info, and destination port index.

methods.name: onPortSelected
methods.description: Handles selection of a MIDI port by establishing a connection to a destination device port.

methods.name: onClose
methods.description: Closes any open MIDI port connections.

methods.name: setConnectedListener
methods.description: Sets a listener to be notified when ports are connected.
